name: Hotel Indigo Grand Cayman
positioning: Design-led Hotel Indigo in Grand Cayman, steps from Seven Mile Beach, with a Beach Club, a rooftop lounge and rooms dotted with local art
best_for: Beach lovers who want a Seven Mile Beach base with a Beach Club
Travelers who like colorful, art-filled design
Guests traveling with pets of any size

facts.text: The hotel is set in Grand Cayman, steps from Seven Mile Beach.
Rooms are clean-lined, in whites, creams and peaches framed with blonde woods.
Rooms include HDTV, Bluetooth radio and rain shower heads.
The hotel has guest rooms with sunrise and sunset ocean views.
The hotel has a swimming pool and an outdoor hot tub.
Catalina's menu celebrates California coastal classics with Korean, Japanese, Chinese and Mediterranean influences.
Pets of any size, weight or breed are welcome at no extra charge.
The hotel is single-use plastic free.
Couples can hold a beach ceremony at sister resort Kimpton Seafire and a reception at Hotel Indigo.
Hotel amenities include bicycles and an in-room pour-over coffee and tea station.
Snorkeling excursions at Stingray City are among the things to do nearby.

highlights.text: The hotel's design features pink seashell paint and local artwork.
Pom Pom Rooftop Lounge offers 180-degree tropical views of Grand Cayman, Latin-inspired cocktails and small plates to share.
Guests can spend the day at The Beach Club, which has chairs, umbrellas, towels and casual bites.
Rooms are dotted with local art and glass vases of native palms.
Guests can enjoy poolside service under the canopy of the beach cabanas.

considerations.text: The hotel is approximately 10 miles from Owen Roberts International Airport.
